def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = 'data/biomedical/input/1-s2.0-S0092867420301070-mmc7.xlsx'
    # Read all sheets as raw tables (strings) to locate serous tumor samples and variant/Mbp field
    sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, dtype=str)
    out = []
    for name, df in sheets.items():
        df2 = df.copy()
        df2['__sheet__'] = name
        df2['__nrows__'] = str(df.shape[0])
        df2['__ncols__'] = str(df.shape[1])
        # Keep only first ~200 rows per sheet to keep output manageable
        out.append(df2.head(200))
    return pd.concat(out, ignore_index=True)
